records.core_purpose: OBS Studio is software for capturing, compositing, encoding, recording and live-streaming video content.
records.audience: People who record or stream video, plus developers and contributors working on OBS.
useful_actions: Open the source repository or contribution guidance
materially_wrong_claims: It is primarily a website
It is only a software library

acceptable_types: password manager application and open-source codebase
records.core_purpose: KeePassXC is an open-source password manager for storing credentials in an encrypted database that can work offline.
records.audience: People who want to manage passwords locally, plus developers and contributors.
materially_wrong_claims: It is a hosted cloud password service
It is primarily a website

records.core_purpose: Audacity is a cross-platform multi-track audio editor and recorder.
records.audience: People who record or edit audio, plus developers contributing to Audacity.
useful_actions: Use the appropriate source branch and build instructions if contributing
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: The repository is undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4
The main branch is not currently the friendliest route for new contributors to Audacity 3.x
materially_wrong_claims: It is only an audio library
It is primarily a website

records.core_purpose: ripgrep is a command-line search tool that recursively searches files for regular-expression patterns while respecting common ignore rules by default.
records.audience: Terminal users and developers who need fast text or code search.
materially_wrong_claims: It is a website
It is a graphical desktop search application

records.core_purpose: bat is a command-line file viewer and cat replacement that adds syntax highlighting and other presentation features.
records.audience: Terminal users and developers who inspect text and source files.
materially_wrong_claims: It is a desktop text editor
It is a website

records.core_purpose: fzf is a general-purpose interactive command-line fuzzy finder and filter for selecting items from lists.
records.audience: Command-line users who want fast interactive selection from files, history, processes and other lists.
useful_actions: Run the finder from the terminal
Configure shell key bindings or completion
materially_wrong_claims: It is a graphical file manager
It is primarily a website

records.core_purpose: This repository contains most of Tailscale's open-source client code, including the tailscaled daemon and tailscale CLI used for private WireGuard-based networking.
records.audience: People operating Tailscale networks and developers working on the client software.
useful_actions: Inspect or contribute to the daemon and CLI source
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: The repository does not contain the mobile GUI code even though mobile apps use code from it
materially_wrong_claims: It is primarily a website
It is only a generic WireGuard library

records.core_purpose: Syncthing continuously synchronizes files between two or more computers with strong emphasis on data safety, security, ease of use and automation.
records.audience: People who want continuous file synchronization between their own computers, plus contributors.
materially_wrong_claims: It is a cloud storage website
It is only a developer library

records.core_purpose: Caddy is an extensible server platform most commonly used as an HTTPS web server, with automatic TLS and modular configuration.
records.audience: People operating web or network services and developers extending Caddy.
materially_wrong_claims: It is a website rather than server software
It is only a command-line file utility

records.core_purpose: Flask is a lightweight Python WSGI web application framework designed to make small web applications easy to start while allowing larger applications to grow.
records.audience: Python developers building web applications and services.
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: Flask deliberately does not force a particular dependency set or project layout
materially_wrong_claims: It is itself a hosted website
It is a complete end-user desktop application

records.core_purpose: Express is a minimal web framework for Node.js used to build HTTP servers, web applications and APIs.
records.audience: JavaScript or Node.js developers building web servers, websites and APIs.
useful_actions: Follow the quick start or examples
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: The current README requires a supported Node.js version and advises reading migration guidance for major-version changes
materially_wrong_claims: It is an end-user website
It is a command-line network daemon

records.core_purpose: Tokio is an event-driven asynchronous runtime and I/O platform for writing reliable asynchronous applications in Rust.
records.audience: Rust developers building asynchronous and networked software.
useful_actions: Add Tokio to a Rust project
materially_wrong_claims: It is a standalone end-user application
It is primarily a website

records.core_purpose: OpenTTD is a transport simulation game based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe that reproduces and extends the original game.
records.audience: Players of transport simulation games and developers or contributors working on OpenTTD.
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: Nightly builds contain newer changes but may be less reliable than stable releases
materially_wrong_claims: It is a transport-planning library
It is primarily a website

records.core_purpose: The Battle for Wesnoth is an open-source turn-based tactical strategy game with a high-fantasy setting.
records.audience: Players of strategy games and contributors to the game.
useful_actions: Download or play Battle for Wesnoth
materially_wrong_claims: It is a strategy-game development framework rather than a game
It is primarily a website

records.core_purpose: ArduinoCore-avr provides the Arduino core and board support used to build sketches for AVR-based Arduino boards.
records.audience: Arduino users and embedded developers targeting supported AVR boards.
useful_actions: Use the AVR board support through the Arduino toolchain
Inspect the core and board definitions
Contribute fixes for supported AVR targets
central_capabilities: Arduino core APIs for AVR microcontrollers
build support for AVR-based Arduino boards
materially_wrong_claims: It is the Arduino desktop IDE
It is a general-purpose website

records.core_purpose: The Raspberry Pi Pico SDK provides headers, libraries and a build system for writing C, C++ or assembly programs for RP-series microcontrollers such as Raspberry Pi Pico devices.
records.audience: Embedded developers and C/C++ developers programming RP-series microcontroller devices.
useful_actions: Set up the SDK and build an example
central_capabilities: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth support on applicable devices
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: Additional APIs not yet ready for the main SDK may live in pico-extras
materially_wrong_claims: It is a Raspberry Pi desktop application
It is only documentation

records.core_purpose: This repository is the source content for MDN Web Docs, containing documentation about web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP and Web APIs.
records.audience: Web developers reading MDN and contributors maintaining MDN documentation.
useful_actions: Read MDN Web Docs on the live site
Build a local preview when editing content
central_capabilities: source content for the MDN site
materially_wrong_claims: It is the MDN browser application itself
It is a JavaScript software library

records.core_purpose: This repository contains the source of The Rust Programming Language book, which teaches the Rust language and is available to read online.
records.audience: People learning Rust and contributors maintaining or translating the book.
useful_actions: Open the source to propose corrections
central_capabilities: online editions aligned with Rust release channels
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: Published release-channel versions can lag corrections already present in the repository
Larger non-error revisions may wait for major revision periods
materially_wrong_claims: It is the Rust compiler
It is a software framework

records.core_purpose: This repository contains the assets and source required to build the Kubernetes website and documentation.
records.audience: People reading Kubernetes documentation and contributors maintaining or localizing the docs site.
useful_actions: Build and preview the site locally
materially_wrong_claims: It is the Kubernetes orchestration software itself
It is a general web application framework

records.core_purpose: OSSU Computer Science is a structured, free self-taught computer-science curriculum assembled from online learning materials to provide broad undergraduate-level grounding.
records.audience: Self-directed learners who want a broad computer-science education and can study independently with community support.
useful_actions: Start with the curriculum and prerequisites
Track progress through Core CS, Advanced CS and the final project
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: The curriculum requires significant independent study and prerequisite knowledge
Its timeline estimate depends on sustained study effort
materially_wrong_claims: It is a software application
It is a single programming course

records.core_purpose: Coding Interview University is a large self-study plan covering computer-science and software-engineering topics to prepare for technical interviews.
records.audience: People preparing for software-engineering technical interviews.
useful_actions: Work through the listed technical topics
Use the checklist and linked learning resources
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: The author explicitly says readers may not need to study as much as the original personal plan
materially_wrong_claims: It is a university or accredited degree program
It is a software application

records.core_purpose: The LLM Course is a free learning curriculum covering large-language-model fundamentals, model-building techniques and LLM application engineering.
records.audience: Learners who want to understand, build, fine-tune or deploy LLMs and LLM-based applications.
useful_actions: Start with the appropriate course section
Follow the Scientist or Engineer learning tracks
central_capabilities: LLM application engineering and deployment track
materially_wrong_claims: It is an LLM software framework
It is a hosted AI application

records.core_purpose: This repository provides the inference implementation for AlphaFold v2 for protein-structure prediction and related AlphaFold research assets.
records.audience: Researchers and technical users running or studying AlphaFold predictions.
useful_actions: Set up and run the AlphaFold inference pipeline
Read the technical documentation and papers
Use the supplied model and baseline resources where applicable
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: AlphaFold-Multimer is described as work in progress and less stable than the monomer system
materially_wrong_claims: It is a general-purpose AI chatbot
It is only a research paper repository

records.core_purpose: TensorFlow Model Garden contains implementations of machine-learning models and modeling solutions intended to demonstrate good TensorFlow practices for research and product development.
records.audience: TensorFlow users, machine-learning researchers and developers using reference model implementations.
useful_actions: Set up the repository and dependencies
central_capabilities: official models used for testing and performance work
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: The repository is a collection rather than one model or one finished application
The project continues to add and update models
materially_wrong_claims: It is a single trained model
It is an end-user machine-learning application

records.core_purpose: This repository publishes datasets and code behind FiveThirtyEight articles and graphics.
records.audience: People analyzing, reproducing or learning from FiveThirtyEight's published data and code.
useful_actions: Follow the accompanying story or code where provided
central_capabilities: supporting analysis code for articles and graphics
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: Sports predictions and forecasts in the repository stopped being updated in June 2023
materially_wrong_claims: It is a live sports forecasting service
It is primarily a software library

records.core_purpose: Vega Datasets is a central collection of more than 70 example datasets used by Vega, Vega-Lite, Altair and related visualization projects.
records.audience: Visualization developers, learners and users of Vega-related tools who need stable example datasets.
useful_actions: Access datasets over HTTP or CDN
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: Individual datasets have their own licensing terms
Some datasets intentionally contain inconsistencies for teaching or data-cleaning exercises
materially_wrong_claims: It is the Vega visualization engine itself
All datasets share one unrestricted data license

records.core_purpose: This repository is a sample and template for developing Obsidian plugins and demonstrates basic Obsidian plugin API features.
records.audience: Developers learning to create Obsidian plugins.
useful_actions: Use the repository as a template
Install dependencies and run the development build
explicit_limits_or_unfinished: It is a starter/sample implementation rather than a polished end-user plugin
materially_wrong_claims: It is the Obsidian application
It is a finished general-purpose Obsidian plugin for end users

records.core_purpose: Prettier for Visual Studio Code is an editor extension that runs Prettier formatting inside VS Code to enforce consistent code style.
records.audience: VS Code users and developers who want automatic Prettier formatting.
useful_actions: Install the extension from the VS Code marketplace
Set it as the default formatter if desired
central_capabilities: support for many source and markup formats
materially_wrong_claims: It is the standalone Prettier core project
It is a full code editor

records.core_purpose: Awesome is a curated directory of high-quality topic-specific resource lists across programming, platforms, computer science and many other subjects.
records.audience: People looking for curated technical resources and maintainers who want to create or contribute to awesome lists.
useful_actions: Read the contribution or list-creation guidance
materially_wrong_claims: It is a software application
It is a programming library

records.core_purpose: Public APIs is a community-curated directory of public APIs from many domains that developers can use in their own projects.
records.audience: Software and web developers looking for public APIs and contributors maintaining the directory.
useful_actions: Open an API entry to evaluate it
central_capabilities: links to third-party APIs across many domains
materially_wrong_claims: It is itself a single public API service
It is a software framework
